verdict.rationale: Kick's docs say the Activity tab is a full, workspace-wide audit trail. Every transaction change, categorization update and sync event is logged with a timestamp and the name of the person or Kick agent responsible, which covers who, what and when. Because all entities live in a single workspace, this plausibly spans the entire ledger. Missing for 10: confirmation that before/after values are shown, explicit coverage of chart-of-accounts, manual journal entry and period-lock changes, per-entity filtering or export of the log, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
